notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional lands.
description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing two other lands, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Mycosynth Gardens' third ability by paying {4} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of World Shaper.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing The Mycosynth Gardens, adding {C}{C}.
The Mycosynth Gardens dies, triggering its second ability, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
The lands enter the battlefield, triggering Amulet of Vigor that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat.
